themes.name: NCTGraphiteDark
themes.description: The current NCT look and the default NCTGraphite theme. Dark pro task-manager idiom: layered blue-gray surfaces, single teal accent, rounded corners, gradient bevel buttons, three font roles (system sans UI, monospace technical, Georgia serif reading).

themes.name: NCTClassicDark
themes.description: Rectangular bevelled pro dark inherited from the noct-code-appkit styleguide (formerly called NCTGraphiteDark in the plan). Sharp corners, 3D bevel highlights, VS Code blue accent, 4px spacing unit with print baseline-grid type, desktop-compact 24px controls, data-app-mode and data-density switches.

tokens.font-mono-tech: ui-monospace, SF Mono, Cascadia Code, Consolas, Roboto Mono, Menlo, monospace

themes.name: NCTTechDesMVD
themes.description: Reserved theme for web artifacts with a technical minimum-viable-demo style: single-file demo-lab pages built from meta.ai chats, as seen in grid-paint-labs. Full-viewport dark canvas with a side or bottom control panel, monospace-everywhere type, violet/cyan accents on near-black, warm paper surfaces for light-mode labs.
notes: Dark labs set JetBrains Mono globally; the dot-shading lab uses Fragment Mono for body with Syne for display headings.
Control chrome shared across labs: 10-11px tracked-out uppercase micro-labels in dim text, range sliders with accent thumb, swatch buttons, 8px panels with 1px borders, thin dark scrollbars.
Neon variant (Grid-Paint-Field-Key): #FF2D95 / #00E5FF / #FF5A2D / #B7FF2D on #0a0a0f — same dark-lab idiom, hotter palette.
